nodes.question: What is the significance of the investigation's findings regarding vulnerable households during crises?
nodes.answer: The findings highlight the need for policy intervention to ensure that vulnerable households are not disproportionately affected during crises such as a pandemic.
nodes.paragraph: Additionally, households that experience severe food insecurity have signifi- cantly increased from 4.9 to 38.6% during the pre- and post-COVID-19 lockdown, respectively. Concerning the investigated households for both the urban and rural strata, the investigation highlights the need for policy intervention to ensure that vulnerable households are not disproportionately affected during crises such as a pandemic. The findings will be useful to policymaking and will advance aware- ness towards achieving the sustainable development goals (SDG). Keywords COVID-19 pandemic Electricity index Lockdown Resilient society Resource accessibility Water, energy and food nexus Extended author information available on the last page of the article Journal of the Knowledge Economy Introduction Water, energy and food are interconnected resources that are crucial for the well- being and livelihoods of humans supported by the sustainable development goals (SDG) (Biggs et al., 2015). However, Nigeria faces significant challenges in manag- ing the water, energy and food nexus because of rapid population growth. As the population grows, the water demand for food production and preparation is enhanc- ing, but access to clean and reliable water sources, particularly in rural regions, is a major concern (Sani & Scholz, 2021).
